# benchmark-latency-budget

> Agent benchmark: answer quality that only counts inside a latency deadline.

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-latency-budget
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-latency-budget
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-latency-budget

36 episode tasks across voice (700ms), UI (2s), and background (10s)
deadlines. Agents use lookup, calendar_get, and search_docs tools; each call
burns virtual milliseconds from a seeded per-task schedule.

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`, plus latency helpers
`totalTimeMs`, `sweepDeadlines`, `summarizeTimes`, `gradeLatency`, and
`LatencyBudgetEnvironment`. `benchmark-latency-budget/api` exports the
fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-latency-budget/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry,
serve, and mcp. Use the mock provider for offline verification.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
Regenerate tasks with `npm run generate:tasks` (seed 20261015).
